experiments.question: Can sparse and dense retrieval and ontology linking recover independently relevant cross-checklist requirements?

primary_endpoint.name: macro_family_recall_at_5
primary_endpoint.definition: Mean over evaluation families of query-level relevant targets retrieved at k=5 divided by independently established relevant targets; undefined queries and incomplete-reference bounds separate.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Freeze minimum useful paired recall gain, review budget and cost limit; no selection on evaluation labels.

experiments.question: Does conservative composition reduce display burden without losing applicable original obligations?

primary_endpoint.name: material_obligation_loss_rate
primary_endpoint.definition: Independent reference-confirmed material lost obligations divided by adjudicable applicable original requirements; unresolved obligations and per-composition risk separate.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Require exact identity conservation and zero unsupported group closure; proposed upper 95% cluster-aware bound <=2% before any promotion, final margin and sample size frozen with expert approval.

experiments.question: Which eligible ontology concept-by-scope cells lack independently verified reporting coverage and which apparent gaps survive audit?

primary_endpoint.name: expert_supported_gap_yield
primary_endpoint.definition: Independently supported candidate gaps divided by audited nominated eligible cells; report all eligible, unknown, partial, covered, excluded and sampled non-nominated cells separately.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Descriptive census and stratified expert audit; no automatic normative gap inference.

experiments.question: How do guideline co-citation and bibliographic coupling relate to independent semantic and ontology graph layers?

primary_endpoint.name: co_citation_semantic_edge_association
primary_endpoint.definition: Descriptive association of normalized co-citation weights with reviewed semantic or ontology-related edges within frozen time/field strata; eligible pair and citation-observability denominators.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Predeclare graph layers, comparison/null models and time windows; exploratory unless independently frozen; no causal or equivalence inference.

experiments.question: Does hybrid graph/vector evidence improve editorial review utility relative to usual review and lexical/simple union comparators?

primary_endpoint.name: confirmed_material_findings_per_reviewer_hour
primary_endpoint.definition: Paired difference in independently confirmed material reporting issues per active reviewer-hour, controlling manuscript and reviewer clustering and review order.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Freeze institution/ethics determination, allocation, sample size, minimum gain and tolerated harm before enrollment; feasibility only if precision is insufficient.

freeze_blockers: Acquire and qualify multiple exact-edition reporting packs and item-level rights; freeze natural cases and family components independent of training.
Freeze relevance, relation, applicability, concept and manuscript reference rubrics, adjudicators and conflict resolution; complete human audit design.
Pin ontology releases, import closure, eligible concept-by-scope denominator and literature-demand/citation snapshots with rights review.
Freeze sample size and cluster precision, primary decision limits, model/checkpoint/runtime/assets, retrieval candidate budgets and graph sensitivity/null design.
Obtain institutional and ethics determination, manuscript permissions and reviewer participation before prospective evaluation.
Record owner-approved protocol freeze and analytical contract hashes; no existing exploratory output can be retrospectively registered.

claims.text: Sparse/dense retrieval and conservative composition can improve review efficiency while conserving applicable source obligations.
limitations: Hypothesis; synthetic development results and local hash declarations are not independent validation.

claims.text: Ontology-linked coverage and independent bibliometric evidence can help prioritize candidate reporting gaps.
limitations: No mapping is a missing-evidence state, not proof of a normative gap; audit and scope required.

claims.text: Hybrid graph retrieval may improve independently confirmed editorial findings per reviewer-hour.
limitations: Requires prospectively qualified manuscripts and reviewers, independent evidence and ethics determination.
